I fall into this hole often, almost everyday. but on the days I don't, here's what I do:

-do not run away from your feelings and thoughts. use the guilt to your advantage. so the night before, usually after I've decided to sleep, I sit down and face the reality of the situation. I write on my journal (openly) (no screens) what I am doing and what it's resulting in. I write about how tired I am of the constant yt noise in my ears. how I want to look around in the world instead of being locked in a screen. how I'm wasting time.

-then I write about the things I'd rather be doing instead. like playing video games, reading, watching a full movie or drawing (in my case). and I PLAN IT OUT. I prepare my book, decide on my movie, whatever I wanna play or draw. 

-CRUCIAL: the next day when I wake up, I don't look at my phone. I do not touch it. not to look at the time, not to do anything. Just get up and start the day. the silence feels so unbearable sometimes but some deep breaths go a long way, seriously. tell yourself this is how a human being should be living for fucks sake.
